desc: Ideation: single XOR-potential DSU handles all bits at once (potentials are full Z XORs, not per-bit parity — the earlier task-list concern about needing 30 DSUs was wrong; xor-potential DSU over integers is valid since constraints are A_x ⊕ A_y = Z over full integers)

Implement DSU with XOR potentials: parent[], size[], diff[] (xor to parent); iterative find with path compression updating xor-to-root; union(x,y,z) with conflict detection (rx==ry and d[x]⊕d[y]≠z → -1); self-loops handled naturally
Aggregate per root: size and per-bit counts of d[v] (iterate set bits of d[v] for efficiency); compute optimal flip mask t per root (bit b set iff sz−cnt_b < cnt_b)
Reconstruct A_v = t[root(v)] ⊕ d[v]; print space-separated, or -1 if inconsistent
Verify edge cases: M=0 → all zeros; self-loop with Z≠0 → -1; isolated vertices → 0; Z < 2^30 so 30 bits suffice; mentally check samples 1–3
